remarks: Luxury Living in this brand new construction. It's a spacious 3 bed tri-plex with 2.5 bathrooms. Everything has been thoughtfully designed with this ultra modern and unique layout. The first floor feaatures an open-concept living and dining area with a stylish kitchen with high end finishes. There is also a half bathroom on the floor. The second floor has 2 large bedrooms with a full bathroom, and a washer/dryer. The 3rd floor is the primary suite. It has a large & beautiful bathroom, a walk-in closet and a private balcony with beautiful open views. Additional highlights include a parking space under the building and a prime location near shopping, dining, parks and I-95.
